Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Central Water Commission (CWC) for filling up technical positions under the Department of Water Resources.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The position notified is Assistant Engineer (Communication) under the Central Water Commission.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 15 vacancies available for the Assistant Engineer (Communication) post through this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in offline mode through proper channel to the designated establishment section of the Central Water Commission.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunication Engineering or Electronics and Communication Engineering.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary scale for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary in Level-7 ranging from Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400 per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is within 60 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to the Establishment-XIII Section, Central Water Commission, 3rd floor, Sewa Bhawan, R.K. Puram, New Delhi-110066.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is offered on a deputation basis for qualified engineering professionals working in eligible government organizations.
